| AC-5 | The system prevents closure of the notification until a documented disposition and corrective action are recorded. | TC-CS-127, TC-CS-133, TC-CS-134, TC-CS-135, TC-CS-137, TC-CS-138, TC-CS-139, TC-CS-142, TC-CS-143 | COVERED |
| AC-6 | A report is available showing complaint volume and trends by material and batch. | TC-CS-125, TC-CS-128, TC-CS-129, TC-CS-146 | COVERED |

## Coverage Gaps and Recommendations

**Coverage Gaps:** None identified — all 22 test cases per strategy have been generated.

**Recommendations:**
1. Prioritize execution of CRITICAL test cases (Phase 1) before deploying to production
2. For automation, implement TC-CS-144 and TC-CS-145 with session management and worklist access patterns
3. Ensure test data includes Sales Orders and Return Orders with intentionally missing fields for NEG scenarios
4. Validate that the SAP test environment has Workflow routing configured for TC-CS-145
5. Create at least 3 closed Quality Notifications with varying materials and batches before executing TC-CS-146
